description: İtfaiye Dairesi Başkanlığı: wildfire hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by İtfaiye Dairesi Başkanlığı. Coverage: İtfaiye Dairesi Başkanlığı. The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wildfire hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Yangın Sayısı; İtfai İstatistikler-yangın; Yapısal Olmayan Yangınlar; Araç Türlerine Göre Yangın İstatistikleri. Formats seen: XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
